Linux:lordsawar.d: Warlords is a video game series created by Steve Fawkner, in which role-playing elements are combined with turn-based strategy in a fantasy setting. Over time, the series introduced new mechanics like hero recruitment, city conquest, and advanced diplomatic systems.

iOS:sims-medieval.d: The Sims Medieval is a life simulation game that was released in March 2011 by Electronic Arts for Microsoft Windows and Mac OS X as part of The Sims series. Set in medieval times, it allows the player to build a kingdom through quest-driven gameplay.

iOS:warhammer-40-000-deathwatch.d: Warhammer 40,000: Deathwatch – Tyranid Invasion is a turn-based tactics video game developed and published by Rodeo Games. It is based on Games Workshop's tabletop wargame Warhammer 40,000. The game has been described as a spiritual successor to Hunters series.
